idea: MineSafety AI gives Latin American mining contractors an offline-first mobile tool that lets field supervisors speak their safety observations in Spanish or Portuguese and instantly turns voice into structured digital reports. Using AI trained on mining-specific terms and local dialects, it eliminates the daily grind of manual typing and note transcription, so hazards get documented and escalated before they cause incidents.

selected_gap.title: AI-Powered Voice-to-Text for Mining Field Reports in Spanish/Portuguese
selected_gap.pain: Field workers waste hours writing reports manually; delays in hazard communication lead to incidents. Existing general transcription tools fail on mining jargon and accents.
selected_gap.why_now: Advances in multilingual NLP and edge AI allow on-device processing; growing demand for hands-free reporting in hazardous environments.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: 5 pilot users transcribing actual field reports, accuracy >90% on mining terms, reduction in report creation time.
selected_gap.risk: Competitors like Voxel may add voice; technical challenge in noisy mining environments.
